staff.ribbon: lines keep spacing_m apart along the centre line's normal; they never cross

wave.centre_y: amplitude * sin(2 pi x / wavelength - phase), x along the segment
wave.phase: 2 pi * flow_speed_mps * t / wavelength_m: the wave travels downstream

clip.name: Staff_Flow
clip.speed: play at flow_speed_mps / profile flow_speed_mps, or drive the weights

notes.emit: one note per clock tick at the stream's source, riding the staff downstream
notes.spacing: flow_speed_mps * 60 / bpm metres between notes: velocity reads as spread
notes.position: the ribbon's centre line at the note's x, plus staff_step * spacing_m / 2 along its normal (0 = middle line); notes move with the wave, so each stays on its crest
notes.yaw: atan of the centre line's slope

bars.emit: one bar line every beats_per_bar clock ticks, on the downbeat
bars.offset: half a note spacing downstream of the downbeat note (between measures)
bars.spacing: beats_per_bar * flow_speed_mps * 60 / bpm metres: measures follow the clock
bars.position: the ribbon's centre line at its x, square to it (yaw as notes)

reeds.greenness: each stage's reed_greenness: dry while muddy, green when clear

Stream_PortHalo.note: port highlighting while a stream is extended
